benefits.text:
Inspired by a beauty as clear as water, Eau Powder Pact setting powder is the perfect choice for skin that is flushed, dull, lackluster or has large pores, giving a smooth matte, natural and featherlight base all day long.
- Skin correction: 4 shades that help flexibly adjust the look of skin tone, improving the look of dull and uneven-toned skin for a fresh, radiant appearance
- Blurs pores and imperfections: Ultra-fine powder particles blend easily into skin for a soft, smooth, natural base.
- Velvet matte effect: Controls excess oil, keeping skin dry, smooth and fresh all day long.

howToUse.text: Use a puff or brush to pick up an appropriate amount and gently sweep it over the whole face or the areas that need oil control and smoothing. Can be retouched during the day to keep the base dry, fresh and even-toned.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: A tone-correcting setting powder that helps blur pores, control oil and finish the base with a natural smooth matte look.

sellingPoints.text: Filter-effect setting powder; covers pores and the skin's surface; ultra-fine powder particles.

texture.text: Fine, light pressed powder that blends easily into skin.

finish.text: Velvet matte / smooth matte / soft filter.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it makes pores disappear, controls oil absolutely, or cures dull skin.
Do not say it treats redness, cures irritation or permanently eliminates redness.
Do not say it actually makes skin pinker or improves skin circulation.
Do not say it actually whitens skin, treats dull skin or changes skin pigmentation.
